title: Integrity Code Series - Week 6 - Multi-Scale Galvanic Corrosion in Smartphone Charging Ports
description:
Galvanic corrosion simulator for USB-C smartphone charging ports under sweat, humidity and pocket-lint electrolyte films. Solves the Laplace equation for electrolyte potential under a 5 V charging bias with Butler-Volmer boundary conditions, and separately computes the mixed potential of the dissimilar metals (Au plating, Ni underlayer, stainless shell, Cu traces) with Faradaic dissolution and oxide film growth over charge cycles. Uncalibrated research model. An inverse Bayesian engine estimates exchange current densities from sparse synthetic galvanic current observations.

The package is the Week 6 entry in the Integrity Code Series of physics-first integrity simulators by Felipe Rocha.
references: Newman J., Thomas-Alyea K.E. (2004). Electrochemical Systems, 3rd ed., Wiley.
Bard A.J., Faulkner L.R. (2001). Electrochemical Methods: Fundamentals and Applications, 2nd ed., Wiley.
